softaculous.overview: EmpandaHub is a self-hosted nonprofit management platform covering CRM, membership, donors, volunteers, events, grants, and finance — all in one multi-tenant application.
softaculous.desc: EmpandaHub is an open-source, self-hosted nonprofit management platform designed for associations and nonprofits. It provides: contact and board management (CRM), tiered memberships with dues tracking, donor management with campaigns and PDF receipts, volunteer rostering and hour tracking, event management with registration and check-in, grant pipeline with funder database and deadline tracking, a unified finance ledger, document library with role-based visibility and public share links, donor engagement scoring, role-based access control (super_admin / admin / staff / volunteer / readonly), and per-organization module toggling. Built with PHP 8.1 and MySQL on a lightweight custom MVC framework — no bloated dependencies.
softaculous.post_install: EmpandaHub has been installed. Login with the admin credentials you provided. For security: (1) Delete the install/ directory or restrict access to it. (2) Ensure config/config.php has permissions 640. (3) Configure SMTP mail settings from Settings → Organization.
